name: El Charro Taco Shop
notes: Restaurant's own site (elcharrotacoshop.com, address 3445 Midway Dr Unit B matches work list) is a client-rendered marketing SPA (lovable.dev) with no menu data in its JS bundle -- only copy. order.online storefront is Cloudflare-gated ('Just a moment...'). Used DoorDash marketplace JSON-LD instead (server-rendered schema.org Menu, 12 sections, 91 raw items). Dropped 'Most Ordered' carousel duplicates, kept 1 unique item from it (Side of Mexican Salsa). Markup test against 1.04/1.10/1.15/1.20/1.25/1.30 divisors found no clean pattern -- prices pass as genuine POS pricing (lots of .99/.50/.25/.00 endings, no single divisor lands them round). Five combo items priced as 'N for $X' -- kept the quantity in the dish name and the listed total as price rather than dividing to a per-unit figure. Section shape (tacos, burritos, plates, breakfast, quesadillas, tortas, nachos, fries) matches a 24hr taco shop.

notes: Two locations linked from the restaurant's own site; used the Point Loma one (2614 Shelter Island Drive) matching the work list exactly. Primary source is the restaurant's own WordPress homepage, which embeds a full size-variant menu (12/16/20oz etc.) directly in server-rendered HTML -- including Gelato (by the scoop, sized), which the Toast storefront omits entirely despite the restaurant's name. Cross-checked 11 overlapping breakfast/cafe items against the Point Loma Toast catalog (__OO_STATE__, Chrome UA) -- all matched exactly (Lox Lovers $14, Breakfast Sandwich $8, Croissant Sandwich $11, Cali Burrito $12, Breakfast Burrito $10, Bagels $4, Yogurt Parfait $10, Fruit Cup $7, Cookie $2). Toast additionally carries a 'Lunch' section (sandwiches/salads/fries) and a 'Boba & More' section, neither of which appear on the WP homepage menu widget -- included both from Toast since they're real, non-overlapping menu content, not merged/averaged against anything. Multi-size drinks recorded as one row per size (name annotated with the size) rather than collapsed to one price.

name: Fairweather Rooftop Bar
notes: Restaurant's own site is behind a Cloudflare challenge for a bare curl/WebFetch UA, but a full browser-header set (Accept/Accept-Language/Sec-Fetch-*) got a clean 200 with the complete Owner.com menu server-rendered in the page (address 793 J St matches work list exactly). Page showed 'Online orders closed' (closed-store gate) but full prices were present regardless, consistent with other Owner.com/Toast gates in this batch being front-end only. Cross-verified WebFetch's summary against a direct curl + tag-strip of the same URL -- identical prices. Dropped the 'Popular' carousel as a full duplicate of items already in Apps & Shares / Burritos & Originals / Dos Tacos (diffed, no unique items). One item, 'Dos Tacos Mix Match', is listed as '$17.00+' (a build-your-own from-price) -- recorded as $17.00 with a note. No cocktail or alcohol menu is exposed on this ordering channel despite the venue's rooftop-bar identity and marketing copy about craft cocktails -- likely excluded from the to-go ordering platform, same pattern seen at other restaurants in this batch (urbn, Rosemarie's). Food and non-alcoholic beverage menu is complete.

notes: Work list's own link is a HungerRush storefront (flippinpizza.hungerrush.com/order/menu/2038) which 302-redirects to a 'Lost' error page under curl and 403s WebFetch -- both blocked. The chain's own marketing site (flippinpizza.com) lists menu-category pages (Pies, Calzones, Lean Green, Flipsides, Extras, Sweet Spot, Sips & Suds) matching this capture's section names, but carries no prices -- pricing requires the client-side HungerRush ordering flow. Used DoorDash marketplace JSON-LD instead; address (3810 Valley Centre Drive) confirmed exact match against the work list. Dropped the 'Most Ordered' carousel as a full duplicate (diffed against categorized items, no unique items). Markup test (1.04/1.10/1.15/1.20/1.25/1.30 divisors) found at most 5.4% of prices landing round under any single divisor -- in the noise band, no markup signature. Section shape (pies, calzones, salads, wings/sides, dressings, cookies, 2L sodas) matches the chain's own category list.
